description: Source code for rio.c, a stream-oriented I/O abstraction layer used in Redis for handling various I/O devices such as buffers, files, connections, and file descriptors. Implements functions for reading, writing, telling position, flushing, and checksum updates, along with higher-level Redis protocol functions.

methods.name: rioBufferWrite
methods.description: Writes data to buffer, appending to the sds string and updating position.

methods.name: rioBufferRead
methods.description: Reads data from buffer if enough data is available.

methods.name: rioBufferTell
methods.description: Returns current buffer position.

methods.name: rioBufferFlush
methods.description: Flushes buffer, which is a no-op for buffer I/O.

methods.name: rioInitWithBuffer
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with an sds buffer.

methods.name: rioFileWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a file, with optional autosync handling.

methods.name: rioFileRead
methods.description: Reads data from a file.

methods.name: rioFileTell
methods.description: Returns current file position.

methods.name: rioFileFlush
methods.description: Flushes file buffer.

methods.name: rioInitWithFile
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with a FILE pointer.

methods.name: rioConnWrite
methods.description: Stub for writing to a connection, not supported.

methods.name: rioConnRead
methods.description: Reads data from a connection buffer, handling buffer resizing and socket reading.

methods.name: rioConnTell
methods.description: Returns total bytes read so far from connection.

methods.name: rioConnFlush
methods.description: Flush operation for connection, implemented as a write with NULL buffer.

methods.name: rioInitWithConn
methods.description: Initializes a rio object for reading from a connection with a specified read limit.

methods.name: rioFreeConn
methods.description: Frees connection buffer, optionally returning remaining unread data.

methods.name: rioFdWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a file descriptor, with buffering and optional flush.

methods.name: rioFdRead
methods.description: Reading from file descriptor not supported.

methods.name: rioFdTell
methods.description: Returns current position in file descriptor.

methods.name: rioFdFlush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to file descriptor.

methods.name: rioInitWithFd
methods.description: Initializes a rio object for writing to a file descriptor.

methods.name: rioFreeFd
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with file descriptor rio.

methods.name: rioGenericUpdateChecksum
methods.description: Updates checksum using crc64.

methods.name: rioSetAutoSync
methods.description: Sets auto-sync threshold for file-based rio objects.

methods.name: rioCheckType
methods.description: Returns type of rio object (file, buffer, connection, fd).

methods.name: rioWriteBulkCount
methods.description: Writes Redis protocol bulk count.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkString
methods.description: Writes Redis protocol bulk string.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkLongLong
methods.description: Writes Redis protocol bulk long long.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkDouble
methods.description: Writes Redis protocol bulk double.
